events.description: Called with the new state each time the overlay opens or closes, from its trigger, a dismissal or the app.
events.name: onOpenChange

props.description: The page: it is drawn inside the one `main` landmark of the shell.
props.name: children

props.description: The sidebar, usually a `Sidebar`; a function receives where it is drawn. Left out, the shell has no sidebar.
props.name: sidebar

props.description: The bar above the page, usually an `AppHeader`.
props.name: header

props.description: The breakpoint under which the frame collapses; AppShell defaults to `md` and TwoColumnLayout to `lg`.
props.name: collapseBelow

props.description: The open state, for a controlled overlay; pair it with `onOpenChange`.
props.name: isOpen

props.description: The starting open state, for an uncontrolled overlay. Native's own name for it is `isDefaultOpen`.
props.name: defaultOpen

props.description: True when the shell sits inside another page: it fills its box and draws no `main` landmark or skip link.
props.name: isEmbedded

props.description: The text of the skip link. Defaults to the `ui` catalogue's phrase in the active locale.
props.name: skipLabel

props.description:
The frame: `flush` (the default) draws the page straight on the background; `inset` draws the header and page as
a rounded card on the app's background, clear of the edges, the look a split `SidePanel` beside it matches.
props.name: frame

props.description: The id of the main region, the skip link's target. Defaults to `main-content`.
props.name: mainId

props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
props.name: ref
